Adjusting exit parameters (stops and TP1s) for super, level, and trendline setups, while increasing level_qty to 18, aims to capture more profit on strong moves (like 5/04) and reduce losses on choppy days. The edge may exist because default parameters are suboptimal for volatile regimes.

- Super quality: stop loss = 15%, TP1 = 75%
- Level setup: qty = 18 contracts, stop loss = 12%, TP1 = 30%
- Trendline: stop loss = 6%
All other parameters (runner_target, etc.) retained as in baseline.
